properties.title: Flash Flood Warning issued July 11 at 5:01PM MDT until July 11 at 7:15PM MDT by NWS Albuquerque NM
properties.description:
At 501 PM MDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
thunderstorms producing heavy rain over the McBride Burn Scar.
Between 0.25 and 1 inch of rain has fallen. Flooding impacts will
continue, but no additional rainfall is expected. Flash flooding is
ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

Excessive rainfall over the burn scar will impact the Gavilan Canyon
and Rio Ruidoso drainages. Impacts will include but are not limited
to all nearby reservoirs, bridges, culverts and roadways. Impacts to
areas along the Rio Ruidoso may extend downstream of Ruidoso Downs.
The debris flow can consist of rock, mud, vegetation and other loose
materials.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding in and around the McBride Burn Scar.

SOURCE...Radar and automated gauges.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
McBride Burn Scar.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Ruidoso, Ruidoso Downs, Glencoe and Hollywood.
properties.instruction:
This is a life threatening situation. Heavy rainfall will cause
extensive and severe flash flooding of creeks, streams and ditches in
the McBride Burn Scar. Severe debris flows can also be anticipated
across roads. Roads and driveways may be washed away in places. If
you encounter flood waters, climb to safety.
